guideMd:
## 1. 环境

Atlas 800T A2 单机 8 卡 · Docker ≥ 24 · Python 3.12 · MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 · 镜像 `mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12`（需提前导入本机）

## 2. 起容器

```bash
docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
docker exec -it mindspeed_llm bash
```

## 3. 代码与依赖

```bash
git clone -b 26.2.0 https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
cd MindSpeed-LLM
git submodule update --init --recursive
git submodule update --init --remote 3rdparty/MindSpeed 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
```

## 4. 权重

从 Hugging Face 下载 Aquila-7B 权重，转到 Megatron 格式：

```bash
bash examples/legacy/aquila/ckpt_convert_aquila_hf2legacy.sh
```

## 5. 数据

```bash
bash examples/legacy/aquila/data_convert_aquila_pretrain.sh
```

## 6. 启动

```bash
bash examples/legacy/aquila/pretrain_aquila_7b_ptd.sh
```

## 7. 验证

```bash
bash examples/legacy/aquila/evaluate_aquila_7b_ptd.sh
```

source.note: 框架级安装 + 框架级/逐模型训练脚本

## 2. 安装依赖

```bash
pip install triton-ascend==3.6.0 --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi
```

```bash
git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed.git
cd MindSpeed
git checkout 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
pip3 install -e .
cd ..

git clone -b 26.2.0 https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
cd MindSpeed-LLM
git submodule update --init --recursive
git submodule update --init --remote 3rdparty/MindSpeed 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
```

## 3. 权重

从 Hugging Face 下载 Baichuan-7B 权重，转到 Megatron 格式：

```bash
bash examples/legacy/baichuan/ckpt_convert_baichuan_hf2legacy.sh
```

## 4. 数据

```bash
bash examples/legacy/baichuan/data_convert_baichuan_pretrain.sh
```

## 5. 启动

```bash
bash examples/legacy/baichuan/pretrain_baichuan_ptd_7B.sh
```

## 6. 验证

```bash
bash examples/legacy/baichuan/evaluate_baichuan_7B_ptd.sh
```

## 1. 环境

Atlas 800T A2 单机 8 卡 · Docker ≥ 24 · Python 3.12 · MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 · 镜像 `mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12`（需提前导入本机）

## 2. 起容器

```bash
docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
docker exec -it mindspeed_llm bash
```

## 3. 代码与依赖

```bash
git clone -b 26.2.0 https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
```


## 7. 验证

```bash
bash examples/legacy/baichuan/evaluate_baichuan_13B_ptd.sh
```

Atlas 800T A2 ×2 节点，每节点 8 卡（共 16 卡）（按实际卡数补 `--device=/dev/davinci1` 至 `--device=/dev/davinci7`） · Docker ≥ 24 · Python 3.12 · MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 · 镜像 `mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12`（需提前导入本机）

## 2. 起容器

每台节点均需执行本节命令，每台节点各启动一个容器。

```bash
docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
docker exec -it mindspeed_llm bash
```

## 3. 代码与依赖

```bash
git clone -b 26.2.0 https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
cd MindSpeed-LLM
git submodule update --init --recursive
git submodule update --init --remote 3rdparty/MindSpeed 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo

pip3 install -r 3rdparty/MindSpeed/requirements.txt
ln -s 3rdparty/MindSpeed/mindspeed mindspeed
ln -s 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo/fsdp_turbo fsdp_turbo
ln -s 3rdparty/Megatron-LM/megatron megatron

pip3 install -r requirements.txt
mkdir logs
```

## 4. 权重

从 Hugging Face 下载 bloom 权重，转到 Megatron 格式：

```bash
bash examples/legacy/bloom/ckpt_convert_bloom_hf2legacy.sh
```

## 5. 数据

```bash
bash examples/legacy/bloom/data_convert_bloom_pretrain.sh
```

## 6. 启动

每台节点执行；`NNODES`、`NODE_RANK`、`MASTER_ADDR` 按脚本内变量填写。

```bash
bash examples/legacy/bloom/pretrain_bloom_176b.sh
```

## 7. 验证

```bash
bash examples/legacy/bloom/evaluate_bloom_176b_ptd.sh
```

source.note: 框架级安装 + 框架级/逐模型训练脚本

## 1. 环境

Atlas 800T A2 ×4 节点，每节点 8 卡（共 32 卡）（按实际卡数补 `--device=/dev/davinci1` 至 `--device=/dev/davinci7`） · Docker ≥ 24 · Python 3.12 · MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 · 镜像 `mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12`（需提前导入本机）

## 2. 起容器

每台节点均需执行本节命令，每台节点各启动一个容器。

```bash
docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
docker exec -it mindspeed_llm bash
```

```bash
git clone -b 26.2.0 https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
cd MindSpeed-LLM

ln -s 3rdparty/MindSpeed/mindspeed mindspeed
ln -s 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo/fsdp_turbo fsdp_turbo

pip3 install -r requirements.txt
mkdir logs
```

```bash
bash examples/legacy/intern/ckpt_convert_intern_hf2legacy.sh
```

```bash
bash examples/legacy/intern/data_convert_intern_pretrain.sh
```

## 6. 启动

每台节点执行；`NNODES`、`NODE_RANK`、`MASTER_ADDR` 按脚本内变量填写。

```bash
bash examples/legacy/intern/pretrain_internlm_65b_ptd.sh
```

```bash
ln -s 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo/fsdp_turbo fsdp_turbo
ln -s 3rdparty/Megatron-LM/megatron megatron
```

## 2. 安装依赖

```bash
pip install triton-ascend==3.6.0 --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi
```

```bash
git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed.git
cd MindSpeed
git checkout 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
pip3 install -e .
cd ..

git clone -b 26.2.0 https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
cd MindSpeed-LLM
git submodule update --init --recursive
git submodule update --init --remote 3rdparty/MindSpeed 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
```

## 3. 权重

从 Hugging Face 下载权重，转到 Megatron 格式：

```bash
bash examples/legacy/qwen/convert_ckpt_qwen_hf2legacy.sh
```

## 4. 数据

```bash
bash examples/legacy/qwen/data_convert_qwen_instruction.sh
```

## 5. 启动

```bash
bash examples/legacy/qwen/pretrain_qwen_14b_ptd.sh
```

## 6. 验证

```bash
bash examples/legacy/qwen/evaluate_qwen_14b_ptd.sh
```

## 1. 环境

Atlas 800T A2 ×16 节点，每节点 8 卡（共 128 卡） · Docker ≥ 24 · Python 3.12 · MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 · 镜像 `mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12`（需提前导入本机）

## 2. 起容器

```bash
docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
docker exec -it mindspeed_llm bash
```

## 3. 代码与依赖

```bash
git clone -b 26.2.0 https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
cd MindSpeed-LLM
git submodule update --init --recursive
git submodule update --init --remote 3rdparty/MindSpeed 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
```

## 4. 权重

从 Hugging Face 下载权重，转到 Megatron 格式：

```bash
bash examples/legacy/qwen/convert_ckpt_qwen_hf2legacy.sh
```

## 5. 数据

```bash
bash examples/legacy/qwen/data_convert_qwen_instruction.sh
```

## 6. 启动

每台节点执行；`NNODES`、`NODE_RANK`、`MASTER_ADDR` 按脚本内变量填写。

```bash
bash examples/legacy/qwen/pretrain_qwen_72b_ptd.sh
```

## 7. 验证

```bash
bash examples/legacy/qwen/evaluate_qwen_72b_ptd.sh
```

Ascend 950DT&PR 单机 8 卡 · Python 3.12 · CANN 按 MindSpeed 配套表安装 · PyTorch 2.10.0 + TorchNPU 26.2.0 · MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0

## 2. 安装依赖

```bash
pip install triton-ascend==3.6.0 --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi

git clone https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed.git
cd MindSpeed
git checkout 26.2.0_core_r0.12.1
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
pip3 install -e .
cd ..

git clone -b 26.2.0 https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
cd MindSpeed-LLM
git submodule update --init --recursive
git submodule update --init --remote 3rdparty/MindSpeed 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
```

## 3. 权重

从 Hugging Face 下载 Qwen2-7B 权重，转到 Megatron 格式：

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen2/ckpt_convert_qwen2_hf2mcore.sh
```

## 4. 数据

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen2/data_convert_qwen2_instruction.sh
```

## 5. 启动

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen2/pretrain_qwen2_7b_32k_ptd.sh
```

## 6. 验证

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen2/evaluate_qwen2_7b_full_ptd.sh
```

source.note: 框架级安装 + 框架级/逐模型训练脚本

guideMd:
## 1. 环境

Atlas 800T A2 ×16 节点，每节点 8 卡（共 128 卡） · Docker ≥ 24 · Python 3.12 · MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 · 镜像 `mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12`（需提前导入本机）

## 2. 起容器

```bash
docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
docker exec -it mindspeed_llm bash
```

## 3. 代码与依赖

```bash
git clone -b 26.2.0 https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
cd MindSpeed-LLM
git submodule update --init --recursive
git submodule update --init --remote 3rdparty/MindSpeed 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
```

## 4. 权重

从 Hugging Face 下载 Qwen2-72B 权重，转到 Megatron 格式：

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen2/ckpt_convert_qwen2_hf2mcore.sh
```

## 5. 数据

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen2/data_convert_qwen2_instruction.sh
```

## 6. 启动

每台节点执行；`NNODES`、`NODE_RANK`、`MASTER_ADDR` 按脚本内变量填写。

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen2/pretrain_qwen2_72b_32k_ptd.sh
```

## 7. 验证

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen2/evaluate_qwen2_72b_ptd.sh
```

source.note: 框架级安装 + 框架级/逐模型训练脚本

Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD 单机 8 卡 · Python 3.12 · CANN 按 MindSpeed 配套表安装 · PyTorch 2.10.0 + TorchNPU 26.2.0 · MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0

## 2. 安装依赖

```bash
pip install triton-ascend==3.6.0 --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi

git clone -b 26.2.0 https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
cd MindSpeed-LLM
git submodule update --init --recursive
git submodule update --init --remote 3rdparty/MindSpeed 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo

pip3 install -r 3rdparty/MindSpeed/requirements.txt
ln -s 3rdparty/MindSpeed/mindspeed mindspeed
ln -s 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo/fsdp_turbo fsdp_turbo
ln -s 3rdparty/Megatron-LM/megatron megatron

pip3 install -r requirements.txt
mkdir logs
```

## 3. 权重

从 Hugging Face 下载 Qwen2.5-Coder-7B 权重，转到 Megatron 格式：

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen25_coder/ckpt_convert_qwen25_coder_hf2mcore.sh
```

## 4. 数据

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen25_coder/data_convert_qwen25_coder_pretrain.sh
```

## 5. 启动

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen25_coder/pretrain_qwen25_coder_7b_32k_ptd.sh
```

## 6. 验证

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen25_coder/evaluate_qwen25_coder_7b_ptd.sh
```

source.note: 框架级安装 + 框架级/逐模型训练脚本

guideMd:
## 1. 环境

Atlas 800T A2 单机 8 卡 · Docker ≥ 24 · Python 3.12 · MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 · 镜像 `mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12`（需提前导入本机）

## 2. 起容器

```bash
docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
docker exec -it mindspeed_llm bash
```

## 3. 代码与依赖

```bash
git clone -b 26.2.0 https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
cd MindSpeed-LLM
git submodule update --init --recursive
git submodule update --init --remote 3rdparty/MindSpeed 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
```

## 4. 权重

从 Hugging Face 下载 Yi-1.5-6B 权重，转到 Megatron 格式：

```bash
bash examples/mcore/yi15/ckpt_convert_yi15_hf2mcore.sh
```

## 5. 数据

```bash
bash examples/mcore/yi15/data_convert_yi15_pretrain.sh
```

## 6. 启动

```bash
bash examples/mcore/yi15/pretrain_yi15_6b_ptd.sh
```

## 7. 验证

```bash
bash examples/mcore/yi15/evaluate_yi15_6b_ptd.sh
```

source.note: 框架级安装 + 框架级/逐模型训练脚本

## 2. 起容器

每台节点均需执行本节命令；示例仅映射 `davinci0`，本机 8 卡需按 `ll /dev/ | grep davinci` 结果补充 `--device=/dev/davinci1` 至 `--device=/dev/davinci7`。

```bash
docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
docker exec -it mindspeed_llm bash
```

## 3. 代码与依赖

每台节点均需执行以下命令，多机时各节点都需准备相同的数据。

```bash
git clone -b 26.2.0 https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
cd MindSpeed-LLM
git submodule update --init --recursive
git submodule update --init --remote 3rdparty/MindSpeed 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo

pip3 install -r 3rdparty/MindSpeed/requirements.txt
ln -s 3rdparty/MindSpeed/mindspeed mindspeed
ln -s 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo/fsdp_turbo fsdp_turbo
ln -s 3rdparty/Megatron-LM/megatron megatron
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
mkdir logs
```

## 4. 权重

从 Hugging Face 下载 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 权重，转到 Megatron 格式：

```bash
bash examples/mcore/deepseek_r1_distill_qwen/ckpt_convert_distill_qwen_hf2mcore.sh
```

```bash
bash examples/mcore/deepseek_r1_distill_qwen/data_convert_distill_qwen_instruction.sh
```

## 6. 启动

每台节点执行；各节点仅 `NODE_RANK` 不同（0…1），`MASTER_ADDR` 均填节点 0 的 IP，`NNODES` 填节点总数。多机且节点间未配置 NFS 等共享存储时，须在启动脚本中增加 `--no-shared-storage`，否则非主节点跨节点读取数据会报错。

```bash
bash examples/mcore/deepseek_r1_distill_qwen/tune_distill_qwen_32b_full.sh
```

## 1. 环境

Atlas 800T A2 ×2 节点，每节点 8 卡（共 16 卡） · Docker ≥ 24 · Python 3.12 · MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 · 镜像 `mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12`（需提前导入本机）

## 2. 起容器

每台节点均需执行本节命令；示例仅映射 `davinci0`，本机 8 卡需按 `ll /dev/ | grep davinci` 结果补充 `--device=/dev/davinci1` 至 `--device=/dev/davinci7`。

```bash
docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
docker exec -it mindspeed_llm bash
```

## 3. 代码与依赖

每台节点均需执行以下命令，多机时各节点都需准备相同的数据。

```bash
git clone -b 26.2.0 https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
cd MindSpeed-LLM
git submodule update --init --recursive
git submodule update --init --remote 3rdparty/MindSpeed 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo

pip3 install -r 3rdparty/MindSpeed/requirements.txt
ln -s 3rdparty/MindSpeed/mindspeed mindspeed
ln -s 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo/fsdp_turbo fsdp_turbo
ln -s 3rdparty/Megatron-LM/megatron megatron
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
mkdir logs
```

## 4. 权重

从 Hugging Face 下载权重，转到 Megatron 格式：

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen3_moe/ckpt_convert_qwen3_moe_hf2mcore.sh
```

## 5. 数据

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen3_moe/data_convert_qwen3_moe_instruction.sh
```

## 6. 启动

每台节点执行；各节点仅 `NODE_RANK` 不同（0…1），`MASTER_ADDR` 均填节点 0 的 IP，`NNODES` 填节点总数。多机且节点间未配置 NFS 等共享存储时，须在启动脚本中增加 `--no-shared-storage`，否则非主节点跨节点读取数据会报错。

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen3_moe/pretrain_qwen3_30b_a3b_4K_ptd.sh
```

## 7. 验证

```bash
bash examples/mcore/qwen3_moe/evaluate_qwen3_30b_a3b_ptd.sh
```

```bash
    --tokenizer-type GPT2BPETokenizer \
    --vocab-file ./vocab_file/gpt2-vocab.json \
    --merge-file ./vocab_file/gpt2-merges.txt \
    --append-eod \
    --workers 4 \
    --log-interval 1000
```

Atlas 900 A3 SuperPoD ×8 节点，每节点 8 卡（共 64 卡） · Python 3.12 · CANN 按 MindSpeed 配套表安装 · PyTorch 2.10.0 + TorchNPU 26.2.0 · MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0

## 2. 安装依赖

```bash
pip install triton-ascend==3.6.0 --extra-index-url=https://mirrors.huaweicloud.com/ascend/repos/pypi

git clone -b 26.2.0 https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
cd MindSpeed-LLM
git submodule update --init --recursive
git submodule update --init --remote 3rdparty/MindSpeed 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo
pip3 install -r 3rdparty/MindSpeed/requirements.txt
ln -s 3rdparty/MindSpeed/mindspeed mindspeed
ln -s 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo/fsdp_turbo fsdp_turbo
ln -s 3rdparty/Megatron-LM/megatron megatron
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
mkdir logs
```

## 3. 权重

从 Hugging Face 下载权重，转到 Megatron 格式：

```bash
bash examples/mcore/glm45-air/ckpt_convert_glm45_air_hf2mcore.sh
```

## 4. 数据

```bash
bash examples/mcore/glm45-air/data_convert_glm45_air_pretrain.sh
```

## 5. 启动

每台节点执行；`NNODES`、`NODE_RANK`、`MASTER_ADDR` 按脚本内变量填写。

```bash
bash examples/mcore/glm45-air/pretrain_glm45_air_106b_4k_A3_ptd.sh
```

source.note: 框架级安装 + 框架级/逐模型训练脚本

guideMd:
## 1. 环境

Atlas 800T A2 ×32 节点，每节点 16 卡（共 512 卡）（按实际卡数补 `--device=/dev/davinci1` 至 `--device=/dev/davinci15`） · Docker ≥ 24 · Python 3.12 · MindSpeed-LLM 26.2.0 · 镜像 `mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12`（需提前导入本机）

## 2. 起容器

```bash
docker run -it -d \
      --ipc=host \
      --network=host \
      --pid=host \
      --name mindspeed_llm \
      --privileged \
      --shm-size=512g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/devmm_svm \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info \
      -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
      -v /data:/data \
      -v /weights:/weights \
      mindspeed-llm:v26.1.0-cann9.1.0-torch_npu2.7.1.post8-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
      /bin/bash
docker exec -it mindspeed_llm bash
```

## 3. 代码与依赖

```bash
git clone -b 26.2.0 https://gitcode.com/ascend/MindSpeed-LLM.git
cd MindSpeed-LLM
git submodule update --init --recursive
git submodule update --init --remote 3rdparty/MindSpeed 3rdparty/FSDPTurbo
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
```

## 4. 权重

从 Hugging Face 下载权重，转到 Megatron 格式：

```bash
bash examples/mcore/glm5/ckpt_convert_glm5_hf2mcore.sh
```

## 5. 数据

```bash
bash examples/mcore/glm5/data_convert_glm5_pretrain.sh
```

## 6. 启动

每台节点执行；`NNODES`、`NODE_RANK`、`MASTER_ADDR` 按脚本内变量填写。

```bash
bash examples/mcore/glm5/pretrain_glm5_744b_4k_A3_ptd.sh
```

source.note: 框架级安装 + 框架级/逐模型训练脚本

guideMd:
## 1. 环境
Atlas 800T A2 ×2 节点，每节点 8 卡（共 16 卡），NPUS_PER_NODE=8，Docker ≥ 26.1.4，Python 3.12，MindFormers 2.0.0 / CANN 9.1.0 / MindSpore 2.10.0。

## 2. 拉镜像
两台机器都拉同一镜像。
```bash
docker pull swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-cann9.1.0-mindspore2.10.0-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12
```

## 3. 起容器
默认只挂 0 号卡，按实际卡数补 `--device=/dev/davinci1:rwm` 至 `--device=/dev/davinci7:rwm`。每个节点各起一个容器。
```bash
docker run -itd \
  --ipc=host \
  --network=host \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name mf-telechat336b \
  swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-cann9.1.0-mindspore2.10.0-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
  /bin/bash
docker exec -it mf-telechat336b bash
```

## 4. 代码与依赖
镜像已内置 MindSpore Transformers、MindSpore、CANN；需 r2.0.0 发布版本代码时在容器内源码安装，自检打印 `All checks passed` 即可用：
```bash
git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
python -c "import mindformers as mf;mf.run_check()"
```

## 5. 数据
预训练数据集 WikiText-103，`wiki.train.tokens` 先转成 jsonl（一行一条，含 `src`/`text`/`type`/`id`/`title`），再转 Megatron 二进制，`--tokenizer-dir` 指向 TeleChat3-36B 的 tokenizer 目录：
```shell
python toolkit/data_preprocess/megatron/preprocess_indexed_dataset.py \
  --input /path/to/data.jsonl \
  --output-prefix /path/to/wiki103-megatron \
  --tokenizer-type HuggingFaceTokenizer \
  --tokenizer-dir /path/to/TeleChat3-36B
```

## 6. 权重
模型权重、Tokenizer、配置从 ModelScope 的 `TeleAI/TeleChat3-36B-Thinking` 下载；从头预训练不需加载权重。

## 7. 启动
配置 `configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml` 的并行为 `data_parallel: 1`、`model_parallel: 8`、`pipeline_stage: 2`、`micro_batch_num: 4`、`use_seq_parallel: True`。两台机器都执行，下为节点 0；节点 1 把 `node_rank` 改为 1，`master_ip` 填 Rank 0 的 IP：
```shell
master_ip=192.168.1.1
node_rank=0
port=50001
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
--config configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml \
--auto_trans_ckpt False \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train" \
16 8 $master_ip $port $node_rank output/msrun_log False 7200
```

## 8. 验证
日志在 `output/msrun_log/worker_0.log`，`step` 递增、`loss` 下降、`grad_norm` 为有限数值即正常；开流水并行时只有最后一个 stage 的日志显示真实 loss，ckpt 存于 `./output/checkpoint`。

source.note: 模型级训练指导

guideMd:
## 1. 环境

Atlas 800T A2 ×2 节点，每节点 8 卡（共 16 卡） · Python 3.12 · MindSpore ≥ 2.10 · CANN 与驱动/固件按所选 MindSpore 配套；宿主机需先装 NPU 驱动与固件。

## 2. 安装依赖

安装 MindFormers 与 HyperParallel（动态图训练必需）：

```bash
git clone -b master https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
bash build.sh
```

```bash
cd ..  # 当前在 ~/mindformers，回到主目录再克隆
git clone https://atomgit.com/mindspore/hyper-parallel.git
cd hyper-parallel
python setup.py bdist_wheel
pip install dist/hyper_parallel-*-py3-none-any.whl
```

环境自检，输出 `All checks passed` 即可用：

```bash
python -c "import mindformers as mf;mf.run_check()"
```

## 3. 数据

`wiki.train.tokens` 先自行转成每行含 `src`/`text` 的 jsonl，`/path/to` 换成数据目录与 tokenizer 目录（放 `/path/to/TeleChat3-36B`），产出 `_text_document.bin/.idx`：

```bash
cd ..  # 当前在 ~/hyper-parallel，回到克隆目录上层
cd mindformers
python toolkit/data_preprocess/megatron/preprocess_indexed_dataset.py \
  --input /path/to/data.jsonl \
  --output-prefix /path/to/wiki103-megatron \
  --tokenizer-type HuggingFaceTokenizer \
  --tokenizer-dir /path/to/TeleChat3-36B # 其他规格的模型可以调整为对应的tokenizer路径
```

## 4. 启动

yaml 里 `data_path` 填 `/path/to/wiki103-megatron_text_document`（不带后缀），两台机器各执行一次，节点 1 把 `node_rank` 改为 1：

```bash
master_ip=192.168.1.1
node_rank=0
port=50001
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
--config configs/telechat3/pretrain_telechat3_36b.yaml \
--auto_trans_ckpt False \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train" \
16 8 $master_ip $port $node_rank output/msrun_log False 7200
```

## 5. 验证

日志在 `./output/msrun_log`，流水并行下真实 loss 只在最后一个 pipeline stage 的日志里，ckpt 存于 `./output/checkpoint`：

```bash
tail -f ./output/msrun_log/worker_0.log
```

source.note: 模型级训练指导

## 1. 环境
Atlas 800T A2 单机 8 卡，NPUS_PER_NODE=8，Docker ≥ 26.1.4，Python 3.12，MindFormers 2.0.0 / CANN 9.1.0 / MindSpore 2.10.0。

## 2. 拉镜像
```bash
docker pull swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-cann9.1.0-mindspore2.10.0-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12
```

## 3. 起容器
默认只挂 0 号卡，按实际卡数补 `--device=/dev/davinci1:rwm` 至 `--device=/dev/davinci7:rwm`。
```bash
docker run -itd \
  --ipc=host \
  --network=host \
  --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \
  --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \
  --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \
  --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \
  -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi \
  -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi \
  -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
  -v /etc/ascend_install.info:/etc/ascend_install.info \
  --name mf-qwen3 \
  swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-cann9.1.0-mindspore2.10.0-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
  /bin/bash
docker exec -it mf-qwen3 bash
```

## 4. 代码与依赖
镜像已内置 MindFormers 2.0.0，拉 r2.0.0 仓库取 `configs/qwen3` 与启动脚本，`run_check` 打印 `All checks passed` 即可用：
```bash
git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
python -c "import mindformers as mf;mf.run_check()"
```

## 5. 数据
`configs/qwen3/finetune_qwen3.yaml` 用 `HFDataLoader` 联网自动下载 `llm-wizard/alpaca-gpt4-data-zh`，离线时把 `path` 改为 `"json"` 并填 `data_files`。

## 6. 权重
从 Hugging Face 或 ModelScope 下载 Qwen3-32B 的权重、Tokenizer、配置，启动时 `--pretrained_model_dir` 指向该目录（如 `/path/to/Qwen3-32B`）。

## 7. 启动
单机 8 卡 LoRA 微调，先在 `configs/qwen3/finetune_qwen3.yaml` 的 `model.model_config` 下加 `pet_config`（`pet_type: lora`、`lora_rank: 8`、`lora_alpha: 16`、`target_modules` 指向 `word_embeddings`/`linear_qkv`/`linear_proj`/`linear_fc1`/`linear_fc2`）；`total_rank_num=8` 为总卡数，`--parallel_config.model_parallel 8` 与卡数一致：
```bash
total_rank_num=8
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
--config configs/qwen3/finetune_qwen3.yaml \
--auto_trans_ckpt True \
--use_parallel True \
--run_mode train \
--pretrained_model_dir /path/to/Qwen3-32B \
--parallel_config.data_parallel 1 \
--parallel_config.model_parallel 8 \
--parallel_config.pipeline_stage 1 \
--parallel_config.micro_batch_num 1 \
--recompute_config.recompute True" \
$total_rank_num
```

## 8. 验证
日志在 `./output/msrun_log`，每卡一份，`worker_7.log` 对应最后一张卡；`step` 递增、`loss` 下降、`grad_norm` 为有限数值即正常，ckpt 存于 `./output/checkpoint`。

```bash
  swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-cann9.1.0-mindspore2.10.0-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
  /bin/bash
```


## 4. 代码与依赖
镜像已内置 MindFormers 2.0.0，拉 r2.0.0 仓库取 `research/qwen2_5` 与启动脚本，`run_check` 打印 `All checks passed` 即可用：
```bash
git clone -b r2.0.0 https://atomgit.com/mindspore/mindformers.git
cd mindformers
python -c "import mindformers as mf;mf.run_check()"
```

## 5. 数据
alpaca 数据在 `research/qwen2_5/` 下先转对话格式 json，再生成 mindrecord，`path` 与 `/path` 换成实际路径：
```bash
python alpaca_converter.py \
  --data_path path/alpaca_data.json \
  --output_path /path/alpaca-data-messages.json
python qwen2_5_preprocess.py \
  --dataset_type 'qa' \
  --input_glob /path/alpaca-data-messages.json \
  --vocab_file /path/vocab.json \
  --merges_file /path/merges.txt \
  --seq_length 32768 \
  --output_file /path/alpaca-messages.mindrecord
```

```bash
bash scripts/msrun_launcher.sh "run_mindformer.py \
 --register_path research/qwen2_5 \
 --config finetune_qwen2_5_7b.yaml \
 --run_mode finetune \
 --train_data ./path/alpaca-data.mindrecord "
```

## 8. 验证
日志在 `output/msrun_log/worker_0.log`，`step` 递增、`loss` 下降、`grad_norm` 为有限数值即正常。

```bash
  --name mf-llama2 \
  swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindformers:2.0.0-cann9.1.0-mindspore2.10.0-910b-openeuler24.03-py3.12 \
  /bin/bash
docker exec -it mf-llama2 bash
```

## 4. 代码与依赖
镜像已内置 MindFormers 2.0.0，取仓库里的 `msrun_launcher.sh` 与配置，`run_check` 打印 `All checks passed` 即环境可用。

```bash

  --data_path /{path}/alpaca_data.json \
  --output_path /{path}/alpaca-data-conversation.json

  --dataset_type qa \
  --input_glob /{path}/alpaca-data-conversation.json \

```
